thread:
maya: Heads-up: GA requirement - pricing safety: we need a kill-switch + shadow billing flow that is testable. owners by EOD pls :triage_box:

oliver: propose kill-switch at tenant routing layer. API: POST /v1/tenants/{id}/safety/kill-switch {"reason":"pricing-spike"}. should be idempotent and log audit entry. owner: oliver.

priya: i'll own reconciliation. acceptance: shadow ledger vs live meter must be within 0.5% token/embedding counts over 72h for 3 traffic profiles. i'll provide sample queries.

tamika: shadow pipeline: fork meter events to `shadow-ledger` topic, mark `charged=false`. retention 90d. owner: tamika. ETA: 4 days.

hannah: monitoring: add alert when shadow vs live diverges >1% for 15m and >5% for 1h. include tenant id and route. owner: hannah.

legal: must not expose shadow as "billing-ready". opt-in language needs explicit consent recorded in audit log. legal will review copy within 4h. owner: legal.

maya: quick behavior decision: if kill-switch enabled mid-flight -> allow in-flight to finish, reject new requests to high-cost variants (drain-inflight). document and test.

oliver: runtime note: implement evaluation order tenant-override -> feature-flag -> global-policy. will add curl examples to docs.

priya: also want a CSV export tool for finance that shows shadow vs charged; i'll add sample CSV format.

ops-bot: task created RW-PLAT-7201 "Shadow billing pipeline" assigned to tamika.

maya: GA acceptance (pricing subset): kill-switch API + docs, shadow-ledger writing CSVs in staging, reconciliation tests green (0.5%), pricing-delta dashboard & alerts, legal-approved opt-in copy, ops runbook for enabling/disabling kill-switch.

hannah: i'll mock divergence events in staging to prove alerts.

maya: thanks. owners - post PRs/tasks by EOD and a staging runbook by tomorrow EOD or escalate. closing thread unless new items.
